7 producers (deviated), 3 water injectors. Completions: frac-pack lower Valysar. Well cost estimate: 850 MNOK total.
Subsea tieback to existing FPSO (12 km). 2 manifolds, dual flowlines. Water injection capacity 35,000 bbl/d.
DG2 approved. Proceed to FEED. Condition: acquire CentralFlanks core data before DG3.
